title: mls-extensions-10 published: bump -09 citations, check new component rules
description:
agora pins draft-ietf-mls-extensions-09: spec/05-messaging.md:105, import/agora-protocol-spec-unified.md:1338, and the citation convention in notes/copyedit-defects-triaged.md:43. -10 is current; the last-resort KeyPackage section is still there (now §6.4 'Last-Resort KeyPackages').

If agora uses app_data_dictionary components, -10 changes:
- app_components MUST be understood and advertised (-10 §4.6; mlswg/mls-extensions#88, PR #93).
- Safe AAD is now the entire authenticated_data, no trailing non-safe bytes (-10 §4.9; #95, PR #96).
- Open issues that may change the rules: mlswg/mls-extensions#102, #103, #105.

agora uses OpenMLS: openmls/openmls#2283 (AppDataUpdate §4.7 checks skipped without a GCE proposal) applies to any AppDataUpdate use.

Detail and line references: mimid bead mimid-1wgh.4.62 (in /home/mark/PROJECT/mimid).
